claims.text: PEAK NIGHT · SUN 13 → MON 14
PEAK NIGHT · SUN 13 → MON 14
Geminids Dec 13
Under a perfectly dark sky, the peak can reach a hundred and fifty meteors an hour.
MOONSET 20:42
MOONSET 20:42
150 meteors an hour in a perfect sky
THU 17 DEC · EVENING

The Geminids peak late on the night of Sunday 13 December 2026, at 23:52 US East Coast time. The radiant in Gemini is highest around 01:52, and the Moon sets at 20:42, so the sky is dark. Up to 150 meteors an hour is the ideal-sky rate (ZHR); from a town expect far fewer. The Moon passes Saturn on the night of 17–18 December, 5.9° at closest, and the pair is best seen on Thursday evening.

Positions computed for the US East Coast (40.7°N, 74°W) with astronomy-engine; meteor rates from the International Meteor Organization. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
